name: BLAW 5750
title: Ethics and Compliance in the Global Organization
description: This course investigates the legal and ethical issues surrounding the compliance function from an organizational perspective. Students will learn about relevant compliance regulations as well as how compliance leaders introduce and sustain an ethical culture of integrity in the enterprise. Compliance will also be viewed from a global perspective, incorporating ethical, legal, and cultural challenges and opportunities in a global compliance program. Students gain experience in how to manage compliance issues, minimize risk of legal non-compliance, and implement compliance initiatives effectively.
requirement_description: Open only to M.B.A, M.S. in Social Responsibility and Impact in Business students, and non-degree business students, others with consent.
